notes: needs_ruling (rule 11): this is al-Faqih's statement of his routes («طرق») to the book of Hisham ibn al-Hakam, with no saying. The four routes are written as the text states them; which of them is the chain of this report is not settled here
«- رضي اللّه عنهما -» is a blessing gloss and is left out; «جميعا» is kept as written, not turned into a tail
«كنيته أبو محمد، مولى بني شيبان، بياع الكرابيس» is a biography, not a link
